SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating Signs (Listening and Speaking) 4.1.1 Observing signed Comprehensi on: Observin g Selectively, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to get the main points from an oral or signed text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating Signs (Listening and Speaking) 4.1.1 Observing signed Comprehensi on: Observin g Selectively together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: Learners develop the signing skills as they fingerspell and articulate signs of vocabulary related to

leadership and good governance.

● Critical thinking: Learners develop active listening or observing skills as they critically listen to oral texts or observe a captioned video

and select information.

Values:
● Integrity: is promoted as learners listen or observe to texts on good governance.

● Social justice: is enhanced as they listen to oral texts or observe captioned video on good leadership qualities.

Link to other Subjects

The learner is able to relate skill of listening and observing, to their learning in Kiswahili, KSL and other learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources
